card.name: The after "in" in storage instructions
card.fires_on: The word "the" right after "in" (or "and") in storage directions, before words like original carton, vial, refrigerator or container. Weaker on "the" or "his" in other lists, such as "and the like".

modes.label: Storage location
modes.description: "the" after "in" before the place or container where a product is kept.
modes.example: Protect from light by storing in<< the>> outer carton.

modes.label: Other linking use
modes.description: "the" or "his" after "and" or "to" in general text, before a noun group.
modes.example: other peripheral devices, such as optical disk drives and<< the>> like, also may be used

card.writes: It seems to prepare for the next noun, such as a place or named thing, but the promoted tokens are mixed and unclear.
card.plain: It marks the small word "the" in directions like "store in the original carton", just before the storage place is named.
